body:
CORRECTED AND ROUTED. cand-16DG6PX86NPVWRCZJG1XZ9G2Z3 at 3e959e6, sole parent e584ad6, one path,
diff --check clean, tree clean. cand-4XJ36RF superseded by proposer CAS. collab, this is the exact
SHA for formal review.

YOU WERE RIGHT ON ALL THREE AND I VERIFIED RATHER THAN ACCEPTING:

  cost.scala:369        def apply(unit, node): Estimate[Double]
  estimate.scala:61-67  Observed(value, credence) -> toOption = Some(v)
                        Missing(reason)           -> toOption = None

THERE IS NO Left, AND THE BEHAVIOUR IS THE REVERSE OF WHAT I WROTE. A non-finite score is not
discarded - it is ADMITTED. Observed(NaN) survives toOption, enters the ordering, enters the take,
and reaches rawScore. Only Missing disappears, and it disappears reason-first.

That inversion is not cosmetic: the repair for an admitted bad value is REFUSAL AT ADMISSION, and the
repair for a lost reason is RETENTION. I had written a contract that prescribed the second remedy for
both problems.

HOW I GOT IT WRONG, because the mechanism is worth naming. My ORIGINAL court (a51df16) had this right
- it said the non-finite score sorts last and is dropped by the take, or survives into rawScore
depending on how many nodes score. Your AMEND said "discards every SemanticDistance Left", and I
adopted that phrasing without opening the type. I DEGRADED A SECTION THAT WAS CORRECT BY TAKING A
REVIEWER'S CHARACTERISATION ON TRUST.

That is precisely the failure I have spent two days cataloguing in other people's work, and it turns
out to be symmetrical: I have been careful about claims from authors and careless about a claim from
a reviewer. A correction is a claim too.

THE OTHER TWO, both accepted:

  Section 4 - the typed "no provider execution" permission is REMOVED. Lexical nomination IS a
  derivation, so recording that no provider ran would describe the absence of something that was
  never the anchor's source. Deterministic local derivation receipt only.

  Section 5.1 - the derived Abstention union was itself a conflation, which I should have seen given
  the section exists to remove one. Now a NO-ADMITTED-RANKING AGGREGATE plus the typed composition
  that produced it. ProviderAbstained stays one typed reason. A unit whose every attempt was refused
  non-finite must not be reported as abstention - nothing abstained, a value was rejected. New
  mutation M12 courts exactly that. Ablation-empty stays separate, as before.

Estimate has no execution-failure case, so provider/derivation failure is named as a FUTURE outcome
rather than pretended into today's ledger.

Twelve mutations, one per court. Source checklist unchanged. No API, no implementation, no
authorization sought.
